metadata.name: Competition Scanner
metadata.description: Researches your competition, creates and/or updates a competitive analysis, emails you when there are notable updates.

metadata.name: Sales Lead Responder
metadata.description: Respond to new leads in real time, understand if they are a net new customer, or new user at existing customer, research them and their company, send them the appropriate email template (e.g. book a demo).

metadata.name: Customer Support Agent
metadata.description: This agent triages customer support tickets and does one of these things depending on the ticket details: resolves the ticket, hands off to a "Customer Feedback" agent, hands off to a "Billing agent", or escalates complex cases to a human.

metadata.name: Automated Chargeback Fighter
metadata.description: Automatically responds to fraudulent chargebacks using pre-approved dispute templates.

metadata.name: Scheduling Assistant
metadata.description: Schedules or reschedules meetings, summarizes your calendar, highlights important events, and tells you when you're free.

metadata.name: Meeting Prep
metadata.description: Sends you a pre-meeting email with attendee bios and key details before external meetings.

metadata.name: Google Docs Copilot
metadata.description: Summarize and critique my document (e.g. product brief, report, etc) before sharing with my boss.

metadata.name: Product Brief Generator
metadata.description: Review roadmap, customer feedback, etc and draft a product brief for me based on a short outline of the feature + an existing template.
